build: Expo development build; Hermes; React Compiler enabled
change: Keep scrub preview text in a per-hook external store; subscribe only ScrubTooltip so preview changes do not rerender StoryDock or its gesture detector. Shared implementation also serves briefing seeking.
method: Reload each variant, warm the same four-gesture flow once, then replay under React and Android native profiling. Only the two scrubber runtime files were switched; other worktree changes were preserved.
preview_filter: Captured commits containing ScrubTooltip and no HomeScreen or StoryCard; Argent retains hot commits and nearby margin commits, so these are selected samples, not every frame.
interpretation: Median rendered components per captured preview commit fell from 18 to 10 (44%). Dock renders in these commits fell from 6 to 0. Median sampled preview commit duration fell from 72.49 to 31.9925 ms in this comparison; timing varied considerably across repeats. This proves less unnecessary rendering, not a consistent whole-screen FPS gain.
native_caveat: Native jank event counts rose from 26 to 30 in this comparison. Dominant CPU frames were emulator GPU transport/kernel work. Combined reports also showed clock alignment issues. No native frame-time improvement or leak fix is claimed.

validation.full_verify: npm run verify: typecheck, lint, deprecated API check, 122 Jest suites / 1293 tests passed before final controlled replay
validation.final_checks: typecheck, lint and diff whitespace check passed; 23 tests in scrub-steps, scrub-camera-claim and gesture-cancellation passed after restoring optimized source
validation.runtime: Recorded flow passed for both variants; inspected rendered main screen; exercised card swipes, story expansion, menu opening/dismissal and briefing seek/pause; no warning/error entries in final connected log registry before Metro stopped

remaining_opportunities: Profile bounded idle batching for initial StoryMeasure card measurement. Source review identified this; no change was made without a targeted startup profile.
Native frame smoothness needs a representative physical-device measurement to separate app cost from emulator graphics overhead.
